fake.description:
Fake task to simulate Ramsey fringe measurement.

Ramsey experiment measures T2* (dephasing time) and refines qubit frequency.
This task takes the initial qubit_frequency from CheckFineChevron and outputs
a more precise qubit_frequency along with t2_star.

Note: Uses same name as qubex task for seamless backend switching.

Inputs:
    qubit_frequency: Initial qubit frequency from CheckFineChevron (GHz)
    hpi_amplitude: Half-pi pulse amplitude from CheckHPI

Outputs:
    qubit_frequency: Refined qubit frequency from Ramsey measurement (GHz)
    t2_star: T2* dephasing time (μs)
    ramsey_frequency: Detuning frequency observed in Ramsey fringes (MHz)
fake.name: CheckRamsey

qubex.description:
Task to estimate the control amplitude.

Sweeps the drive frequency around the operational control frequency
(``control_frequency`` ± ``frequency_span``) using the dedicated 1024 ns
Qubex spectroscopy readout pulse and fits a sqrt-Lorentzian
to scale the drive amplitude so that the resulting Rabi rate matches
``target_rabi_rate``.
qubex.name: CheckControlAmplitude

frequency_span.description: Half-span around control_frequency for the sweep (±span, default ±150 MHz)

frequency_step.description: Frequency step (default 2.5 MHz, ~120 points over ±150 MHz)

shots.description: Number of shots per frequency point. Higher than the usual CALIBRATION_SHOTS (2048) because this is a 1D scan and the phase response can still be small near the spectroscopy-derived seed amplitude — extra averaging is needed to get the signal above the noise floor for a stable sqrt-Lorentzian fit.

simultaneous_drive.description: Whether control and readout pulses start together. False starts readout after the control pulse ends.

target_rabi_rate.description: Target Rabi rate used to scale the estimated control amplitude

qubex.description:

The first qid is the measured/control qubit and the second is the spectator/target qubit.
Frequencies and anharmonicities used by the estimate are resolved from QDash calibration
inputs rather than from Qubex's implicit anharmonicity fallback.

control_qubit_frequency.description: Calibrated GE frequency of the measured/control qubit

target_qubit_anharmonicity.description: Optional calibrated anharmonicity of the spectator/target qubit

target_qubit_frequency.description: Calibrated GE frequency of the spectator/target qubit

time_range.description: Wait time in each half of the JAZZ echo sequence

qubex.description:
Task to check the resonator spectroscopy.

This is a MUX-level task that performs spectroscopy on all resonators
with the dedicated 8192 ns Qubex spectroscopy pulse. The scheduler executes it once
per MUX, and the result will be used by all qubits in that MUX.

Note: task_type remains "qubit" for frontend compatibility, but
is_mux_level=True indicates this task runs once per MUX.
qubex.name: CheckResonatorSpectroscopy

frequency_range.description: Frequency range as [start, stop, step] in GHz. Leave blank to use the connected readout box's qubex default: low band [5.75, 6.75, 0.002], high band [9.75, 10.75, 0.002].

power_range.description: Power range as [start, stop, step] in dB. The qubex default is [-60, 5, 5] dB. The stop value is exclusive.

resonator_assignment_order.description: Qubit offsets within each MUX in increasing resonator-frequency order. Enter a JSON array containing each offset from 0 to 3 exactly once. The default is [3, 0, 2, 1]. For 16Q, use [0, 3, 1, 2] when the frequency order is mux[0] < mux[3] < mux[1] < mux[2].

shots.description: Number of shots for resonator spectroscopy

qubex.description:
Center the readout pulse in the capture window of each MUX.

This is a MUX-level task: it runs once for the representative qubit and
writes the same capture delay to every qubit in the MUX: ``capture_delay``
and ``capture_delay_word`` on QuEL-1, ``capture_delay`` in ns on QuEL-3.
The delay is a setting of the MUX, so the task captures only the
representative qubit's readout at a fixed tone frequency. The capture units
of a MUX read the same ADC samples, so capturing more qubits adds no information.
qubex.name: CorrectCaptureDelay

capture_delay_ns_range.description: QuEL-3: capture_delay sweep as [start, stop, step] in ns. Every value must be a multiple of 0.8 ns. The stop value is exclusive.

capture_delay_word_range.description: QuEL-1: capture_delay_word sweep at the chosen coarse delay as [start, stop, step] in 8 ns words. Every value must be a multiple of 4 words (32 ns).

delay_range.description: QuEL-1: coarse capture_delay sweep as [start, stop, step] in 128 ns units. The stop value is exclusive.

readout_duration.description: Readout pulse duration shared by the Qubex calibration session.

readout_frequency.description: Fixed readout tone frequency used for every capture. Choose a frequency inside the readout band but away from the resonators; resonator calibration is not required. Leave blank to use 0.25 GHz above the connected readout box's default resonator spectroscopy range: 11.0 GHz for the high band and 7.0 GHz for the low band.

shots.description: Number of averaged shots per capture

smoothing.description: Moving-average window used to locate the pulse plateau

snr_threshold.description: Minimum signal-to-noise ratio of a detected pulse edge
